_scenario_metadata.scenario_name: Mettur Dam — Hypothetical Worst-Case Overtopping Breach (Baseline)
_scenario_metadata.scenario_classification: HYPOTHETICAL EMERGENCY PLANNING SCENARIO — NOT A FORECAST
notes: All SCENARIO ASSUMPTION parameters are explicitly labelled as such.
No scenario assumption may be silently upgraded to AUTHORITATIVE status.
Breach volume 500 MCM = 18.9% of total 2644 MCM reservoir capacity.
Froehlich (2008) breach formation time: tf = 0.0179 * Vw^0.364 * hb^-0.564.
Conservative factor 0.90 applied to Froehlich tf per Phase 4 methodology.
Manning n values from Chow (1959) — explicitly labelled SCENARIO ASSUMPTION.

initial_water_level_m.source: WRD TN Full Reservoir Level (FRL) = 790.0 ft × 0.3048

active_breach_volume_mcm.source: Phase 5 engineering judgment — 18.9% of total capacity. NOT MEASURED.

breach_formulation.value: Froehlich (2008) overtopping + broad-crested weir release + strict mass conservation
breach_formulation.source: Froehlich, D.C. (2008). Predicting Peak Discharge from Gradually Breached Embankment Dams. J. Hydrologic Engrg. ASCE.

breach_depth_m.source: Dam height = breach depth for full overtopping failure. CWC; WRD TN.
breach_depth_m.notes: For gravity masonry dam: complete overtopping failure assumed for worst case

breach_bottom_width_m.source: Froehlich (2008) regression: Wb = 0.1803 * Ko * Vw^0.32 * Hb^0.19; Ko=1.0 (overtopping); Vw=5e8 m³; Hb=65.23 m → Wb≈75 m. Rounded to 80 m.
breach_bottom_width_m.reason_for_rounding: Rounded to 80 m for consistency with conservative planning range

breach_side_slope_z.unit: H:V (0.5 = near-vertical, typical gravity masonry breach)
breach_side_slope_z.source: Von Thun and Gillette (1990); NWS BREACH model default for masonry gravity dams
breach_side_slope_z.notes: Less trapezoidal than an earthfill breach (z=1.0) — gravity masonry fails in near-vertical block

breach_formation_time_hr.reason_for_factor: 0.90× conservative factor per Phase 4 Idukki approved methodology: faster breach produces higher peak discharge, more conservative for emergency planning
breach_formation_time_hr.notes: Explicitly classified SCENARIO ASSUMPTION. Not a measured value.

weir_coefficient_rectangular.source: Chaudhry (2008) broad-crested weir; USACE HEC-RAS default

timestep_sec.notes: Baseline dt=60 s. Sensitivity: also run at 30 s and 15 s.

simulation_duration_hr.notes: 12 hr captures full hydrograph recession for 500 MCM active volume

inundation_threshold_m.source: Standard European Flood Directive minimum inundation threshold (JRC, 2017)

main_channel.source: Chow (1959) Table 5-6 — clean Cauvery main channel, no boulders. Lower than Idukki Periyar gorge (0.035) — wider, less confined.
main_channel.chow_category: Natural stream with clean bottom, no vegetation

floodplain.source: Chow (1959) — light brush, trees, agricultural land downstream of Salem

study_domain.note: Study domain covers dam (11.8028N 77.8017E) and downstream Cauvery reach to ~22 km east
